title: Clarence Page's photo album and Midwest touring
summary: He wants Clarence Page's album of Midwest bandsmen, apologises for wavering, and describes playing around Indianapolis with a band Fats Waller fronted.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: Anyhow, I'm going off and on, and it seems like I'm wavering. I don't mean to waver like that, but these little
things hit me at certain times, and I must express it while I've got them there. Because if I don't, then I'll skip them and miss them. You understand?
Sure. Don't worry about that at all. It's all right.
So, Fats Waller got this...got him to get the band, and he fronted it, like, and we played different places around -- Indianapolis and all around, you know.
